# Text 2 Speech — Free Text to Speech Online

> Text 2 Speech (at text-2-speech.com) is a free online text-to-speech tool that turns written text into natural, lifelike speech. It offers 322 AI voices in 75 languages, works in any browser with no sign-up, and lets users listen instantly or download the audio.

Key facts:
- Price: free. No account or sign-up is required.
- Voices: 322 AI voices across 75 languages and regional variants, male and female.
- Input: plain text in any supported language; text files can be imported.
- Controls: speaking speed and pitch adjustment; [break:200ms] / [break:2s] pause markers insert exact silences (Ctrl+B inserts a 500ms pause).
- Output formats: MP3 or WAV audio, plus SRT and VTT subtitles generated from word-level timings.
- Preview: every voice can be previewed with a short sample before generating.
- Character limit: 5,000 characters per generation; longer text should be generated in parts.
- Privacy: generated files exist only for the visitor's current browser session and are removed afterwards; downloads happen promptly by design.
- Commercial use: personal and learning use is fully covered; anyone using generated audio commercially should make sure the use complies with applicable laws and the rights of the text converted.

- [Home — text to speech tool](https://text-2-speech.com/): the generator itself, with voice picker, preview, speed/pitch controls and downloads.
- [Tutorial](https://text-2-speech.com/tutorial.html): how to make voiceovers with Text 2 Speech, step by step.
- [Support & FAQ](https://text-2-speech.com/support.html): help, quick fixes and contact.
- [Privacy Policy](https://text-2-speech.com/privacy.html): how data is handled.
- [Terms of Service](https://text-2-speech.com/terms.html): the terms of use.
